target.title: fix(plugins): pretag pack checks stop hanging on stalled commands
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where release operators running the fast plugin pretag check could have the entire check hang indefinitely when a plugin runtime build, npm pack, or ClawHub pack child process stalled.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each child command now uses the same 10-minute ceiling as the existing npm release-check and shrinkwrap commands, with `SIGKILL` so a child that handles `SIGTERM` cannot keep the synchronous caller blocked. Timeout errors identify the failed release stage and safe command label without forwarding child output or environment details.

## User Impact

Plugin release preflight now exits with an actionable stage-specific timeout instead of blocking indefinitely. Successful builds and packs retain their existing behavior and a full 10-minute per-command budget.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.test.ts` — 3/3 passed.
- `oxfmt --check scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.ts test/scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.test.ts` — passed.
- Targeted Oxlint for `scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.ts` — passed.
- Real stalled-child proof: a child that ignored `SIGTERM` returned `ETIMEDOUT` with signal `SIGKILL` after the test deadline.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

The broader local changed gate passed its preliminary guards, formatting, declaration contracts, and dependency checks, then stopped in the shared dependency install on unrelated type errors in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` and `src/infra/boundary-file-read.ts`. Exact-head CI is the authoritative clean-install typecheck.
